_note: Story 039: the payment moment on the results. prices: pretend money the client pays the salon (display only; the wallet gets the tip). tipShares: how the tip is itemised (each share is weighted by how well that part went; the rest is 'service'). timing (ms): when each beat shows; the whole sequence must stay under maxTotalMs. charge (story 059): the Total step before the payment, pre-filled with the price agreed in the chat (agreedTotal) or the menu price. Charging more than she expects costs overMoodPerDollar mood per dollar (at most overMaxMood) and multiplies her tip by overTipFactor; the agreed price is neutral; an unasked discount is a discountMood lift. Her tip follows what she pays (tip x charged / menu price). chips: the quick -$ and -% buttons. minShare: the lowest total, as a share of the menu price.
